name: AIUC-1 AI Agent Certification Standard
description: First certifiable standard for AI agents. Covers data & privacy, security, safety, reliability, accountability, and societal impact.

operator_action_required.description: Data processing agreements and privacy policies must be documented by the operator. Ancilis generates the evidence these documents cite.
Transparency report published at least annually. Ancilis evidence records provide the underlying data.
Policy prohibiting use of agent for CBRN or cyberweapon assistance must be documented by operator.
